mods.name: Localized Weather
mods.description: Per-zone localized weather with biome-aware rules and smooth transitions.

mods.name: Localized Weather
mods.description: Weather happens per 256x256 zone instead of world-wide: rain, snow, hail and thunderstorms run on their own schedules, biome rules decide what falls, and moving single-cell thunderstorms drift along the wind carrying a rain wall and trailing rain bands. Zone edges blend, so you can stand in sunshine and watch a storm roll in over the hills.
